Yuan Tianmu, inspector of Bing province, was a fifth-generation descendant of the imperial clan; he was close to Erzhu Rong, who treated him as an elder brother.
Yuan Tianmu, inspector of Bing province, was a fifth-generation descendant of Tuoba Gu; he was close to Erzhu Rong, who treated him as an elder brother.
孤 is Tuoba Gu, not the imperial clan in general.
The empress dowager was suspicious and answered: "Moqi Niannian has been executed, Baoyin taken, Chounu has sued for surrender, and Guanlong is pacified.
The empress dowager was suspicious and answered: "Mozhe Niansheng has been executed, Baoyin taken, Chounu has sued for surrender, and Guanlong is pacified.
念生 is the rebel Mozhe Niansheng.
Then she issued an edict: "Consort Pan had in truth borne a girl; therefore Yuan Zhao, heir of Prince Bao of Lintao, descended from Gaozu, should receive the great mandate.
Then she issued an edict: "Consort Pan had in truth borne a girl; therefore Yuan Zhao, heir of Baohui, Prince of Lintao, descended from Gaozu, should receive the great mandate.
臨洮王寶暉: the prince is Baohui.

Erzhu Rong and Yuan Tianmu agreed that the Martial Prince of Pengcheng had served the dynasty faithfully and that his son Yuan You, Prince of Changle, enjoyed wide esteem—they resolved to enthrone him.

Erzhu Rong and Yuan Tianmu agreed that the Martial Prince of Pengcheng had served the dynasty faithfully and that his son Yuan Ziyou, Prince of Changle, enjoyed wide esteem—they resolved to enthrone him.
Zheng Xianhu had long been close to Yuan You; when he heard the new emperor had been enthroned, he and Zheng Jiming opened the city gates.
Zheng Xianhu had long been close to Emperor Xiaozhuang; when he heard the new emperor had been enthroned, he and Zheng Jiming opened the city gates.
敬宗 is the temple name of Yuan Ziyou, Emperor Xiaozhuang.

In summer, the fourth month, on bingshen, Prince You with his elder brother Shao, Prince of Pengcheng, and his younger brother Zizheng, Prince of Bacheng, stole across the river from Gaozhu; on dingyou they met Rong at Heyang, and the host shouted ten thousand years.

In summer, the fourth month, on bingshen, Prince You with his elder brother Shao, Prince of Pengcheng, and his younger brother Zizheng, Duke of Bacheng, stole across the river from Gaozhu; on dingyou they met Rong at Heyang, and the host shouted ten thousand years.

Then he loosed his troops upon them. From Chancellor Wang Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, Minister of Works Yuan Qin, and Director of the Three Offices with Equal Standing Wang Lue, Prince of Yiyang, downward, more than two thousand perished.

Then he loosed his troops upon them. From Chancellor Yuan Yong, Prince of Gaoyang, Minister of Works Yuan Qin, and Director of the Three Offices with Equal Standing Yuan Lue, Prince of Yiyang, downward, more than two thousand perished.
高陽王雍 is Yuan Yong and 義陽王略 is Yuan Lue (imperial Yuan clan).
Former Palace Attendant Wang Zunye and his brothers were in mourning for their father; their mother was a cousin of the emperor's mother, and they went out together to welcome him—all were killed.
Former Palace Attendant Wang Zunye and his brothers were in mourning for their father; their mother was a maternal aunt of the emperor, and they went out together to welcome him—all were killed.
從母 is a maternal aunt.

Rong had already sent the Bingzhou man Guo Luosha and the western Gaoche Chilie to kill the emperor's attendants on the pretext of guarding him; they seized the emperor and pulled him into the tent while the others killed Shao and Zizheng; then he sent more men to move the emperor to Heqiao and confine him under a tent.

Rong had already sent the Bingzhou man Guo Luosha and Chilie Shagui of the western Gaoche to attend at the emperor's side on the pretext of guarding him; they seized the emperor and pulled him into the tent while the others killed Shao and Zizheng; then he sent more men to move the emperor to Heqiao and confine him under a tent.
殺鬼 is part of the name; 侍帝側 means attending at the emperor's side.
Director of the Imperial Clan Yuan Chen argued that it must not be done; Rong snapped, "What is it to you that you are so stubborn?
